def solve(case):
    nodes = case["nodes"]
    required_symbols = case["required_symbols"]
    # Build maps
    node_map = {}
    children = {}
    for node in nodes:
        node_map[node["id"]] = node
        children.setdefault(node["id"], [])
    for node in nodes:
        parent_id = node.get("parent")
        if parent_id is not None:
            children.setdefault(parent_id, []).append(node["id"])
    # Count symbols
    symbol_count = {}
    for node in nodes:
        sym = node["symbol"]
        symbol_count[sym] = symbol_count.get(sym, 0) + 1
    # Initial retained set
    retained = set(node_map.keys())
    # Sort nodes by depth descending, then id ascending
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))
    removed = []
    for node in sorted_nodes:
        nid = node["id"]
        if not node.get("removable", False):
            continue
        # Check retained children
        has_retained_child = any(child in retained for child in children.get(nid, []))
        if has_retained_child:
            continue
        # Check required symbols after removal
        sym = node["symbol"]
        ok = True
        for req_sym in required_symbols:
            cnt = symbol_count.get(req_sym, 0)
            if sym == req_sym:
                cnt -= 1
            if cnt <= 0:
                ok = False
                break
        if ok:
            # Remove
            retained.discard(nid)
            symbol_count[sym] -= 1
            removed.append(nid)
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    return {
        "removed_node_ids": removed,
        "retained_node_ids": retained_sorted
    }
